svg.title: Floor-area ratio & building form
svg.desc: Three 32 by 32 metre plots. Coverage 50, 25 and 12.5 percent times 2, 4 and 8 floors each yields 1024 square metres and FAR 1. Source claims: equal-density. These are the retained editorial geometry examples. Flat footprint relief is decorative. User requested 3D massing with scale context: assumed floor-to-floor height 3 m, trees 5 m, people 1.75 m and cars 5 × 1.8 m. Actual counted floor areas and land-area denominators must be checked separately.
